summary: Slide-to-deploy control whose pixel trail heats up as you drag; releasing past 90% bursts, runs a deploy scan and shows Live.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version shown in the "Live · <version>" label. Read when the deploy goes live.

events.name: deploy
events.description: Fires when the slide is committed and the deploy sequence starts.

events.name: live
events.description: Fires 1.6 seconds after `deploy`, when the label switches to Live.

methods.description: Runs the deploy sequence immediately, as if the thumb had reached the end. Ignored while deploying or live.

properties.name: version
properties.description: Version shown in the Live label; reflects the `version` attribute, or `v2.14.0` when it is missing.

keyboard.action: Slide the thumb to the end on its own and deploy.
Move the thumb 10% along; reaching the end deploys.

accessibility: The thumb is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Slide to deploy"`, `aria-valuemin="0"`, `aria-valuemax="100"` and a live `aria-valuenow`.
The track label is an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces "Deploying…" and "Live · <version>".
Keyboard and pointer input are ignored while a deploy is running or showing Live.
motion: With reduced motion, an early release returns the thumb at once, the trail does not jitter, the label shimmer stops and the burst, sparks and thumb pop are skipped.
notes: The component does not deploy anything; listen for `deploy` and `live` to drive real work.
The host carries `data-state="deploying"` and then `data-state="live"`; it returns to idle 2.6 seconds after going live.
The track is 56px tall and fills the host's width.

data.note: The deploy run and the Live state are simulated on a timer, not on your deploy; only `version` can be set.
